pf.license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks

pf.services.capacity: One estimator or planner per booking; one paving day at a time per crew; the office's design table is saved with long sessions
pf.services.skills: Estimates and running a job: paving foremen. Plan consults: planners. Striping, saw cutting and trucking: subcontractors.
pf.services.nobody_home: Estimates, crack filling and sealcoating: nobody needs to be home if the gate is open. Paving days: an adult on the booking is reachable by phone.
pf.services.online: A plan consult can be a video or phone call (counts as at the office)
pf.services.smallest_job: A switch the owner sets: the smallest job taken, with smaller requests pointed elsewhere (the example takes no paving job under 500 square feet).

after_time: Who will sign the contract? Everyone on the deed should be at the estimate visit

pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the property, or someone with the owner's written OK. A renter's job needs the owner to sign.
studio: Which area, and a rough budget (on the secure page)

stop.words: gas smell, hissing near a gas line, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.
stop.booking: no booking; a new request must say the home was made safe

stop.words: a hole or sinkhole opening in the ground, a retaining wall leaning and moving
stop.says: Keep everyone and every car away from it, and call 911 if anyone is at risk.

steps_then_go_on.words: water pooling against the house or running across the driveway
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep away from wet outlets and switches. We'll look at it first.

steps_then_go_on.words: a sunken patch or a broken edge that people or cars could trip on
steps_then_go_on.says: Mark it, keep people off it, and we'll look at it first.

pf.safety.business_line: Questions about paving over old asphalt, or about drainage, go to the business's own line

pf.first_steps.before_quote: The estimate visit at the property, with everyone who will sign there
after_contract: The cancel window ends before any work or orders, where the state's rules give one
The permit, pulled by the license holder in the business's name, where the work needs one
The utility marks checked before any digging, and the forecast checked for the paving day
The asphalt order and the equipment, set once the window ends
prep: Move cars off the driveway for the whole work window

pf.visit.check_in: Estimate visit: the check-in code at the door. Each work day: that day's code, or the lockbox and a start photo when nobody is home. Office: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The estimator measures, probes the base and photographs; the written quote follows within 3 business days, good for 30 days
pf.visit.changes: A written change order, priced and signed by both, before any changed work. Soft ground, a thicker base or buried items are priced this way.
pf.visit.outside_checks: A base check before the paving, and a final check, where the permit requires them
pf.visit.done: The final check where needed, then the walk-through and punch list, then DONE on the last work day; the cure notes go with it
pf.visit.studio_done: DONE after the consult, with the planner's notes and the picks saved for the estimate
pf.visit.before_photos: The driveway, cracks, low spots, and anything nearby that could be hit (mailbox, sprinklers, edges)

pf.money.estimate: The example's $89 estimate visit is credited to the job; billed only if no contract follows. A free estimate is the safe start.
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: On project work, nothing is taken before the contract is signed by everyone on the deed
pf.money.deposit: Only after signing; the deposit cap comes from the state's form
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.stages: Each stage is billed only when it's done and any check has passed: the start, the paving, the finish. Never ahead of the work
pf.money.change_orders: Added to the next stage bill
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the paving foreman texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.tax: Tax on materials and labor follows the state's form
pf.money.studio: The 3D driveway preview's $55 is credited to the job if Alex signs; the $20 missed-consult fee only after Sam OKs it

never_in_texts: Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in

pf.staff.roles: Paving foremen (Hank, Eli): estimates, quotes and running the job, with the crew. Planners (Dena, Vic) at the office.
pf.staff.licenses: The company holds the contractor registration or license. Where the state's form also licenses each person, each one may add a number (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie). Subcontractors hold their own, as the business says.
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Another paving foreman may take an estimate visit; a job keeps its paving foreman unless Sam moves it

pf.rules.contract: A written contract for project work where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on the deed and by the business before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice)
pf.rules.cancel_window: A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; work and orders wait for it
pf.rules.permits: Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's
pf.rules.change_orders: Written and signed by both before the changed work
pf.rules.final: The final check and any permit sign-off before the last payment
pf.rules.lien_waivers: Lien waivers from the business and its subcontractors with the last payment, where the state's rules provide them
pf.rules.show: The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.warranty: 1 year on workmanship (the example's). Light surface marks and color changes from normal curing are not a defect; the contract says what is covered.

pf.edges.weather: Rain, cold or extreme heat on a paving day: the day moves, with no fee; the paving foreman checks the forecast the day before
pf.edges.asphalt_late: The asphalt plant or the truck is late: wait, or move the day, with no fee to the customer
pf.edges.truck_cannot_reach: The truck can't reach the work: the paving foreman calls Alex first; hand work goes on a change order
pf.edges.hidden_conditions: Soft ground, a thin base or a buried item found at tear-out: a change order before the fix
pf.edges.line_in_the_way: A marked utility line is in the way: the crew plans around it; the start may move a day or two
pf.edges.permit_late: The start moves with no fee; Alex is told
pf.edges.inspection_fails: The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the next stage and its bill wait
pf.edges.cure_time: No cars on new asphalt for the days the paving foreman names; no sealcoat for the first months
pf.edges.cancel_after_window: Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own
pf.edges.nobody_home: Estimates, crack filling and sealcoating with the gate open, with start and end photos
pf.edges.over_license_limit: Not offered, and the owner is told why
pf.edges.walk_through_dispute: Goes to Sam; the last bill waits
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
Started from contractor (pattern: project): an estimate visit, a written quote, then a contract and stage bills. Facts, switches, settings and money paths are the parent's, re-worded for this work: documents, stages, photos, extrawork, firststeps, multiday, banktransfer, video; switch cancelright in flow B only (work sold at the customer's place); arrive A a set start, B a 2-hour window; cutoff 24 hours before.
Flow B main path visit|none|bill: the booking is the $89 estimate visit, credited to the job; Hank's written quote; the contract signed by everyone on the deed; $840 to start, $5,040 when the new asphalt is down, $2,520 at the finish (a $8,400 driveway repaving). The $89 keeps the master's numbers true; a free estimate is the owner's choice (pf.money).
B money paths: visit|none|bill, visit|none|own, visit|card|bill, photos|deposit|bill (Patch repair, $640 from photos, a $160 deposit). Left out: list paths. Crack filling ($179) and Driveway sealcoating ($150) are in pf.services, but the master's booking cards name one list service, so a list path would show the wrong name (MASTER).
Flow A is Sam's second company, Lee Paving Office, a paving office (the master's Lee's Barbershop). Main path list|card|counter: a $35 plan consult with Dena, a card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee, paid at the office desk. The other three: list|none|counter, list|full|none (3D driveway preview, $55, credited to the job if Alex signs), list|deposit|counter (driveway design package, $140, $40 deposit).
Flow A can be a video or phone plan consult (fact `video`): the owner's lot plan and photos are enough to talk through a layout, so the A4-01 video branch is on.
Own steps: A8-x01 (the plan consult offers the estimate visit at home), B8-x06 to B8-x08 (the permit and the paving-day forecast are checked first; a late permit moves the start with no fee; a bad forecast moves the paving day with no fee) and B8-x11 / B8-x12 (soft ground under the old asphalt: a change order first, signed by both).
Asphalt needs dry, warm weather and a firm base: the forecast is part of the first steps (B8-x06 / B8-x08, pf.edges weather), soft ground is a change order (B8-x11), cars stay off new asphalt for the days the paving foreman names, and sealcoating waits a year (the DONE note, pf.edges cure_time).
Booking choices: B timing settime, times window; A times setstart. Nothing is sent now (S2-30 'Yes' branch off, no `sentnow` fact), so nobody is on call.
Plug-in splits kept whole (splitsKept): A7-15; B5-34, B7-55, B8-58, B8-69 (as the parent).
Names: Hank and Eli are the crew leads (the master's Jordan and Casey), Dena and Vic the planners (Riley and Avery). None of them is a master customer's name. Addresses: 520 Rail Rd (the company), 18 Park Ave (the office), 41 Maple Dr (Alex). License numbers use an obviously fake format (PV-00123, SC-00456, PO-00789).
Every state rule is a switch from the state's form: the license and its job-size limit, the written contract and its parts, the deposit cap, money kept apart, the cancel window, permits, lien waivers, what must be shown. No state, city or number from one.
keep: color (a real word of this work), the estimate visit (the trade's own word), leak and valve (the master's safety examples), roofing (the work it doesn't do).
Rename: the contractor's pairs re-worded for this work (master sentences first, then phrases, then single words); 'cut' and 'hair' words that the master uses for its barbershop are turned into this work's words or removed (S1-38, S1-60, S13-55, B8-34).
